[LNUL.8.1] **Null ordering — below-all.** For the *internal* deterministic total
order (fact ordering / dedup / hash), `null` sorts **below all values** — the
substrate tie-break that cannot be narrowed away. Author-facing order operators
(`<`/`>`/`min`/`max`) over a `T?` still **propagate `null`** ([LNUL.4.1]); the two
coexist ([LNUL.6.2]).
